fomod.Name: NextGen Disk Cache
fomod.Author: Archost; derivative maintained by SenjuWoo
fomod.Description: An SKSE64 load cache. It learns which game files and archive ranges Skyrim reads at start-up and during the first save load, then reads exactly that data into the Windows file cache in parallel at the next launch. Recording never changes a game request; saves and writes are never touched. Includes Safe, Minimal and Experimental profiles and logs load timings so you can measure the gain.
